title: Dark card close-ups pulling out to a status line
summary: Two tight crops of a near-black payment card, each with an oversized wordmark that lights up and fades to a hairline outline, then a cut out to the whole card and a one-line status message that slowly grows over it.
use_when: A fintech or banking launch where a physical or virtual card is the hero
A premium, quiet 1:1 product moment with no UI to show
Closing a longer film on a delivered or activated state
A silent autoplay loop where the wordmark must carry the brand

look.type_style: wordmark: heavy geometric grotesk, sentence case, tight, overflowing the frame (cap height about 30 % H in close-ups); status line: regular grotesk, sentence case, 4 % H, mid grey; tiny attribution lockup 2 % H

sfx.event: wordmark lights up in a close-up or on the full card

structure.shot: close-up on the card's top-left corner: masked number tail top, oversized wordmark start bottom, overflowing right edge
structure.camera: drift 1.00->0.99 (block match -0.2 to -0.5 %/s), card edge fixed at sheet resolution
structure.motion: wordmark fill lights up 0.00->1.50 (45 fr, easings.inOutSine, ±0.25 s); number tail lights 0.77->1.00; fill fades to a hairline outline 1.77->2.00 (±0.25 s); outline dims to 2.97

structure.shot: close-up on the card's top-right corner: network mark top, wordmark tail bottom, both fully lit on the first frame
structure.camera: drift, pan under 4 px/s at 1920 wide, card edge fixed at sheet resolution
structure.motion: no entrance (lit on the cut, 1 fr seam at f89 from a 30 fps strip); hold 1.5 s; fill fades to outline 4.50->5.77 (38 fr, easings.inOutSine, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: cut out to the whole card centred at 47 % of frame width, almost black, wordmark only a ghost
structure.camera: static (card position and width unchanged across cells)
structure.motion: card face holds dark; card lower edge fades into black (vertical gradient)

structure.shot: whole card: wordmark across the lower half and small network mark top right light up
structure.motion: wordmark light-on 7.00->7.50 (15 fr, easings.inOutSine, ±0.25 s); network mark from 7.27 (±0.25 s); hold 1.8 s

structure.shot: status line, 4 words, says the card has arrived, over the card centre; tiny attribution lockup (label, mark, wordmark) below
structure.camera: static on the card; the status line alone scales 1.00->1.15 over 150 fr, decelerating
structure.motion: line and lockup fade in 9.33->9.80 (14 fr from a 30 fps strip, easings.outQuint); line scale creep easings.outQuint 150 fr; card wordmark dims behind the line
everything fades 15.25->16.27 (31 fr, easings.linear, ±0.25 s); not fully black on the last frame

params.brand: any brand.json: display font for the wordmark, text font for the status line, muted grey, near-black surface
params.content.wordmark: brand word printed huge on the card (defaults to brand name)
params.content.cardDigits: last 4 digits shown after the masked dots
params.content.networkMark: small mark in the card's top-right corner (your own, never a real network logo)
params.content.status: one status line, about 4 words, e.g. the card is ready
params.content.attribution: small label before the lockup under the status line ('' = none)
params.aspect: 1:1 by default; 4:5 and 9:16 keep the card at 47 % of width

notes: Two cuts (2.97 s f89, 6.00 s f180) are missed by cuts.json because the frames are near black; both found on 30 fps strips. Wordmark fill lights up then fades to a 1 px outline: proposed term 'outline-ghost' (not in vocabulary). Status line scales 1.00->1.15 while the card stays still. Whole film sits below 10 % luminance except the status line (#9C9C9C). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (silent reference).
